rules.text: If the pie-chart inscriptions are the dashboard's comparable Europe smartphone market-share values, and Apple’s displayed value exceeds every other displayed brand value, then Apple is the current market-share leader; if the stated promotion rule allocates the budget to that leader, the Apple promotion option is supported.
rules.conditions: This bridge assumes the slice labels accurately encode the current Europe market-share values and that the dashboard is the evidence source specified by the task.

observations.content: The chart title visibly reads "Smartphone Market Share in Europe".

task_evidence.content: Use the dashboard market-share values as the evidence source; the premium retail promotion budget is reserved for the current market-share leader.
Select the brand with the highest current market share
Select Apple for the premium EU retail promotion budget

chains.option_label: Select Apple for the premium EU retail promotion budget
chains.claim: Conditionally, the displayed Apple value is higher than each other displayed value, so Apple is the chart-indicated Europe market-share leader and the Apple promotion option follows the stated allocation rule.
